component.name: orbitop
component.summary: System monitor for CPU, memory, GPU, network and processes
Systemmonitor für CPU, Speicher, GPU, Netzwerk und Prozesse

description.p: orbitop shows the load of your computer at a glance: processor, memory, graphics card, network, disks, sensors and the running processes.
orbitop zeigt die Auslastung Ihres Rechners auf einen Blick: Prozessor, Speicher, Grafikkarte, Netzwerk, Laufwerke, Sensoren und die laufenden Prozesse.
The hint about missing counter rights now says when the switch "Release counters" is on but has no effect, for example after an update of intel_gpu_top, and that switching it off and on again helps.
After the window reloads, a finished installation of the Intel GPU tools no longer shows the button "Install" again; the hint shows the command of the distribution at once.
Keyboard focus no longer gets lost when the footer disappears, and the sort arrow in the process list has the same size on every system.
Quitting orbitop during an installation no longer contacts PackageKit after the cancel.
From this version on, release tags are signed; the README lists every reason why the counter release can be refused as unsafe.

New switch "Release counters" in the settings of the About dialog: with the admin password, it lets every account read the GPU counters of intel_gpu_top and the RAPL energy counters, and it locks them again.
New button "Install" in the hint about missing Intel GPU tools: it installs them through PackageKit.
Hints can be hidden and shown again in the settings.
Package triggers keep the counter release when the Intel GPU tools are installed or updated; removing orbitop locks the counters again.
Security hardening: orbitop runs pkexec only if it is the setuid program of polkit, and it waits longer after each refused password prompt before it asks again.
Packages for Debian, Ubuntu, Fedora, openSUSE and Arch Linux from a signed package source; new versions come with the regular system update.
New setting: start orbitop at login.
The helper that ends processes of other users is part of the package and has its own polkit action.
